name: hermes-sandbox-probe

arguments.command: probe=$(mktemp) && printf 'ARIES_MOCK_FILE_OK\n' > "$probe" && test "$(cat "$probe")" = ARIES_MOCK_FILE_OK && rm "$probe" && printf 'ARIES_MOCK_FILE_OK\n'

final_response: The scripted sandbox probe finished. Benchmark verification is separate; this probe does not solve the task.
